For general check ups only. When my senior dog was actually sick, I got turned away and told she couldn’t be seen for weeks. So I went and spent 2x the month on the actual animal hospital.
It doesn’t matter if you’re a regular or not. They won’t help a sick dog unless you anticipate the illness and schedule an appointment as their schedule permits. Too bad.

Absolutely the best VCA I have ever been to. We just moved to the neighborhood and I have a VERY reactive puppy who needed his shots. EVERY SINGLE PERSON from greeting to leaving was SO patient, kind, and understanding. Cannot recommend VCA Marina Bay Cities enough. THE BEST!

DO NOT GO HERE, UNLESS YOU'RE FILTHY RICH!  The people who are in charge and make decisions at this veterinarian hospital are WAAAYY more interested in overcharging and taking your money--knowing how much you must love your pet(s) and manipulating that affection you have for your pet--than actually treating and caring for your injured pet.  Our cat injured his leg and the hospital wanted to charge more than $1,000--just for a diagnostic!--and that's before they were willing determine a treatment.  Turns out our cat only had a sprained leg.
Dr. Milo is the best

I got my first kitten a few months ago and bring her here for all of her wellness visits and vaccinations, and everyone is so nice. When I got my baby, she had fleas, worms, the works. I took her in and it was a good decision.

I signed up for the Careclub subscription plan, which makes everything I need for her first year super predictable and gives me peace of mind. It came with all the vaccines, two fecal tests, microchip, and unlimited visits. It covered the cost of the deworm, which was really nice.

Dr. Thornbury is knowledgable and all of the vet techs are wonderful and so good with Debbie.

I never have to wait too long and am usually in and out of there within 45 minutes, and it's never too stressful for my kitty. Highly recommend!
Excellent facility, with very kind and knowledgeable Doctors and Nurses and Staff.
Caring staff, wonderful doctors.  We have been taking our dogs and cats to the Marina VCA for many, many years and have consistently experienced knowledgeable, compassionate care.
Excellent care and supper nice!
$50 to trim some nails. Unreal. A manicure costs $30. This level of price gauging should be a crime, super duper rip off.

Always wonderful people, great veterinarians and such a clean, welcoming environment
I do wish you guys would offer. There are many consultation or mini visit.As sometimes I don't need a full physical for my pet.But just need to ask the veterinarian.A couple of questions.

Pro tip, the first exam is free. But make sure you download the coupon and show them at checkout.  In general I think they charge too much for an exam visit
But other exams I had feco tests are pretty reasonable.

It's just frustrating having to spend $125 adjust to have your pet be seen.
Thank you so much for the 5 stars! We’re grateful for your support and happy to care for your pet anytime.

Veterrian excellence!

I have been a customer of VCA Marina Bay Cities for over ten years.  Recently, my dog had a $1,000 surgery.  A day and a half later, the bandage they put on her unraveled.  So I popped in for what I thought would be a simple thing -- replace the bandage.  First, they had me wait an hour, and then informed me it would cost $43!
And mind you, this was a bandage that they had put on themselves -- and it didn't last 36 hours!

Thank you to the amazing Dr. Tarazi, the vet techs and the front desk staff!  This team went over and above to take care of my dog. They have are kind, compassionate and explain everything thoroughly while giving affordable options. I am very grateful for how gentle and good they were to my dog. This team truly cares about each animal and treat them with so much love.
My boss needed me to bring in their dog for an annual check up. I believe the person that helped me was Vanessa, she was very informative and answered all my questions. Overall great visit.
Great staff

We had been taking our cat here for years despite it being super pricey due to how close it is to where we live, but last time we had to take him somewhere else as it was urgent and they didn't have availability. Now they denied a refill of his necessary medication because we hadn't taken him to VCA in a while, refusing to get sent his blood results from the other place and ignoring my messages. My cat has been without medicine for a week while I move him to a different place and I am extremely disappointed with this place as I genuinely thought that despite trying to get as much money as possible from you they still cared about the animals, but I guess that is not true.

We have been going to This clinic in Marina Del Rey for three years, it is a great place for all the beautiful animals! The doctors are amazing, caring, thorough, knowledgeable, honest, prompt, friendly to pets and their parents!
The staff are incredible especially Emily the office manager and Chris the sweetest, helpful, compassionate, thorough, prompt, alert, aware, loving of pets and respectful to their parents
Truly the best person to see when you walk into this clinic
Thank you💐 from samira, firdos and Theodore
Thank you so much for your review, Dave! We’d love to hear more about your experience with VCA Marina Bay Cities - your feedback means a lot to us! 💙  …

Absolutely avoid this vet. The staff and doctors and friendly and nice but they will lock you into 1 year care club contracts and dishonestly charge you. I brought my dog in as she was due for a few vaccinations and my care club was about to expire (which covers for those vaccinations). I made sure that the appointment was few days in advance of appointment. When they brought the authorization charges out to me, I asked the tech if they were covered and she confirmed they would be. However when I checked out, the front desk informed me that her vaccinations were not covered since my care club had already expired. I explained the situation and informed them that I would not have made the appointment so late and would not have authorized the vaccinations if I had known I would have had to pay out of pocket for them. The desk person said she would have to speak to management but said I could leave and they would follow up. Now several weeks later, they are charging me for the same vaccinations without any explanation. This is the reason why I am ending both of my pets care club and finding a new vet. Oh and by the way, they never sent any notices my pets vaccinations were due so I wouldn't have used them anyways if I hasn't called myself,yet they were charging me monthly. Stay away from this dishonest and shameful business.
Friendly staff, clean waiting area, veterinarians help you make the best decisions for your pet's health. Have been a client for over 2 years.
Great staff, excellent customer service.

This place is a scam!!

I recently visited this veterinary hospital for a simple follow-up vaccination for my pet, but the experience was far from straightforward. Although it was supposed to be a routine vaccination, I was unexpectedly charged for a full examination that was never disclosed to me upfront. This felt like a deliberate attempt to upcharge and take advantage of pet owners who trust them with their pets’ well-being.

When I questioned the hidden charges, the assistant’s behavior was shockingly unprofessional. Rather than addressing my concerns, the Asian lady assistant abruptly left, angrily slammed the door, and made me feel completely disrespected. The manager later returned, claiming it was ‘procedure’ to do a follow-up exam, yet when I asked why this wasn’t done for my other cat during the same type of visit, they had no clear answer and seemed to be making things up on the spot.

During a previous visit with my other kitten, someone simply took her in for the vaccination and returned her to me without any additional examination or hidden fees, which made this situation even more frustrating and inconsistent.

It’s disappointing that this hospital appears to lure clients in with the promise of care, only to impose extra fees without consent. Transparency and respect should be fundamental in any business, especially when it comes to caring for our pets. I would strongly advise others to be cautious, ask questions upfront, and honestly, to consider other options.
They were the nicest when my dog tore his dew claw, saw him quickly, took care of him well and didn’t cost an arm and a leg. Great staff thank you so much!!!

Great vets, nurses and staff.
We've been bringing our pets here for 10 years and counting.

I had the pleasure of having Kris from VCA as my Customer Service Rep, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Kris is incredibly helpful, respectful, and genuinely caring. She made me feel truly heard and valued as a customer, going above and beyond to address my concerns with patience and understanding. Her professionalism and warmth are a great representation of the office, and I always feel reassured knowing that Kris is there to help.
The staff is always helpful

If I could leave 0 stars I would. I called on June 8th to cancel my membership, followed up on the 11th, and they canceled my membership on the 12th but ALSO CHARGED ME $201.50 for June 12-July 12. I brought my dog in for his teeth cleaning today, July 1st, and they told me it would be covered when I set the appointment.

Dropped him off at 7:15 this morning, to get a phone call that he’s no longer under Club Care. They tried to charge me $1,800 to proceed with the teeth cleaning, and I said he’s covered until July 12th. Then they came back saying they can apply the $200 toward his teeth cleaning to make it $1,600. I asked for a refund since he’s no longer under the care and they don’t do refunds. I said you can’t cancel and charge me on the same day, also it should have been canceled on the 8th, when I called, or the 11th when I followed up. I now have to drive 30 minutes to go get my poor dog that has been there for 3 hours, with no refund, and no teeth cleaning.

STAY AWAY FROM THIS VET AT ALL COSTS. THEY ARE UNPROFESSIONAL AND STEAL MONEY.

Avoid this vet at all costs. They truly do not care about your animal and treat you as a number. They routinely miss important items during exams and are very poor with customer service. Go to any other VCA in the area before this one. Dr. Thatcher is derelict and negligent and should be avoided at all costs.
